name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She is caught mid-turn in a spinning cast, one leg lifted behind her, both arms sweeping upward in a spiral gesture that draws a cyclone of air around her, her head turned back to the camera with a bright, playful gaze. A strong wind lifts her gown, scarves and hair dramatically. Casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: A shimmering cyclone of wind, visible as streaming ribbons of cloud and {{MAGIC}} light, spirals around her with leaves and petals caught in it.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
